system: Senior adversarial distributed-systems reviewer. No tool calls, no file reads, no coding. Judge concrete design flaws; do not flatter or demand impossible mathematical certainty. Avoid repeating objections already mitigated unless residual trace is demonstrated.
prompt: ANTITHESIS ROUND 3: narrow re-review of concrete amended safety protocol for four-agent Room. Your prior Round-2 blockers were: B1 authoritative Git vs relay/Allen ACK, B2 silence masking model failure, B3 Git heartbeat storms, B4 shadow arm state contamination, B5 non-falsifiable numeric gates. Are there any NEW critical or high severity engineering blockers remaining in these five areas? For each give exact trace and minimal fix + test. Also independently judge whether plan's phase ordering makes sense, note semantic ambiguity of user ACK if mirror down, and check stable ID after non-fast-forward git race. If you see no new blocking flaws, explicitly say so, while distinguishing design review from executed proof. ≤1100 words, no generic reassurance.
context: v3 PLAN saved in docs/research/room-human-conversation-implementation-plan-20261024.md branch research/conversation-sequence-evidence-20261024. The detailed safety protocol is fully summarized below, so DO NOT call tools.

A Typed outcomes: BeatResult chosen_silence|spoken|no_eligible_participant vs generation_failed|validation_failed|model_unavailable|infrastructure_failure. Only healthy decision advances last_healthy_beat_at. Invalid model must increment independent fault counter. Watchdog reads health and faults. Periodic health coalescing T=300s (<900s watchdog), but accepted user input and public turns always durable immediately. No speech fabricated, monitor word repetition only for human alert.

B Git authoritative public transcript; Cloudflare relay recoverable mirror, subject to checking user-facing contracts. Per committed_sequence stable on durable state + floor_decision_id and inbound Allen IDs (distinct domains), don't hash generated words; stage exact text and state local temp->validate->commit; push before delivery; non-fast-forward check already upstream, else replan from newest durable state with NEW decision ID; never attach stale utterance to newly changed context; mirror outbox persisted as pending, retry 500/dedup on stable source-ID, only confirm delivered on ack, never swallow error. ACK Allen once durable authoritative Git commit confirmed, processed_inbound_ids persisted; duplicate ACK allowed if idempotent, no duplicate public event; relay failure remains pending and visible. Byte-equal utterance for same durable decision; entirely recomputed decision may differ with new ID.

C isolation: standalone clone with sandbox writable root, no production token/relay/ACK, no shared state/memory/sleep state, shadow output separate, immutable fork, control state hash unchanged with shadow ON/OFF; canary independent namespace.

D evaluation: 300 judged outputs by 2 independent annotators, rubric 0=unrelated 1=partial 2=proper response/refusal/repair; κ≥0.60, action 2≥80%, CI; recipient classifier on ≥100 predictions: precision≥90%, coverage≥80% on unambiguous, 95% lower bound≥0.85, ambiguous false certainty≤10%; paired A/B ≥100 directed & 100 repair/refusal examples, multiple seeds, target response+repair improvement≥10 pp with CI, ≤5 pp continuity regression. Production stop on single privacy leak, lost ACK, duplicate ID, or cross-arm write; no deployment if model fails. The thresholds are preregistered candidates, need baseline calibration and feasible sample-size study.

Phases are now P0 baseline/safety/corpus, P0B fixed model capability and topic ablation, P1 silence & publication/ACK state, P2 remove hidden forced novelty and validate legal short repeated repair, P3 soft observer-scoped action inference, P4 next-speaker floor before expression, P5 grounding/pacts/memory, P6 A/B and canary. All changes default off with production main intact.
expected_response: Narrow failure-oriented verdict; remaining block count; whether a fourth round is necessary before implementation planning is considered sufficiently challenged.
